panels.title: 失敗率（成員 × repo；failed+errored / (total - canceled)）
panels.description: 排除 is_post_merge 與 is_deploy_event。對照月報第 1 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT m.display_name AS member, r.full_name AS repo, b.status, b.is_failure FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event), agg AS (SELECT member, repo, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'CANCELED') AS denom, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED') AS fails FROM base GROUP BY member, repo) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN fails || '/' || denom || ' (' || (fails * 100 / denom) || '%)' ELSE '-' END AS rate FROM agg ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: 失敗成本（成員 × repo；GHA Linux $0.008/min）
panels.description: (failed+errored) duration 加總 × $0.008/min。canceled 不計。對照月報第 2 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT m.display_name AS member, r.full_name AS repo, COALESCE(SUM(b.duration_seconds) FILTER (WHERE b.is_failure AND b.status <> 'CANCELED'), 0) / 60.0 * 0.008 AS cost FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event GROUP BY m.display_name, r.full_name) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN cost > 0 THEN '$' || to_char(cost, 'FM999990.00') ELSE '-' END AS cost FROM base ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: PR 迭代次數（成員 × repo；builds / PRs）
panels.description: 理想 = 1.0；越高代表 PR 反覆推 commit。對照月報第 3 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH pr_builds AS (SELECT m.display_name AS member, r.full_name AS repo, b.pr_number, COUNT(*) AS build_count FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND b.is_pull_request AND b.pr_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.display_name, r.full_name, b.pr_number), agg AS (SELECT member, repo, SUM(build_count)::int AS builds, COUNT(*)::int AS prs FROM pr_builds GROUP BY member, repo) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN prs > 0 THEN builds || '/' || prs || ' (' || to_char(builds::float / prs, 'FM990.0') || ')' ELSE '-' END AS iteration FROM agg ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: PR size × Review latency（中位 / p90 / p100，含未 review lower bound，小時）
panels.description: 對照月報第 4 表。未 review PR 用「now（或月底）- ready_at」當 lower bound。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT pr.size_bucket, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(pr.first_review_at, pr.merged_at, pr.closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0 AS lat_h, (pr.first_review_at IS NULL) AS unreviewed FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.size_bucket IS NOT NULL), per_bucket AS (SELECT size_bucket AS bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS median, to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p90, to_char(MAX(lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p100, COUNT(*)::text AS n, NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unreviewed)::text, '0') AS unreviewed FROM base GROUP BY size_bucket), overall AS (SELECT 'Overall' AS bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS median, to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p90, to_char(MAX(lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p100, COUNT(*)::text AS n, NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unreviewed)::text, '0') AS unreviewed FROM base), combined AS (SELECT * FROM per_bucket UNION ALL SELECT * FROM overall) SELECT bucket, median, p90, p100, n, unreviewed FROM combined ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 WHEN 'Overall' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR review latency（成員 × size；中位 / p90 (n=N)，小時）

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT m.display_name AS member, pr.size_bucket, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(pr.first_review_at, pr.merged_at, pr.closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0 AS lat_h FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = pr.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.size_bucket IS NOT NULL) SELECT member, size_bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h/' || to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h (n=' || COUNT(*) || ')' AS cell FROM base GROUP BY member, size_bucket ORDER BY member, CASE size_bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR Review latency 月趨勢（各 size bucket median，小時）
panels.description: 每月各 size bucket 的 median review latency，含未 review lower bound。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', pr.pr_created_at) AS time, pr.size_bucket AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(pr.first_review_at, pr.merged_at, pr.closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0) AS value FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.size_bucket IS NOT NULL AND (pr.first_review_at IS NOT NULL OR pr.merged_at IS NOT NULL OR pr.closed_at IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 每日 passed build 中位時間（每 repo 一條，分鐘）
panels.description: 對照月報第 6 項。passed only，不過濾成員。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', b.started_at) AS time, r.full_name AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.duration_seconds) / 60.0 AS value FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND b.status = 'PASSED' AND b.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 失敗 build 清單（無 cause）
panels.description: 對照月報第 7 項。cause 分類待 schema + classifier 接入後再加。

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.started_at AS "date", m.display_name AS "member", r.full_name AS "repo", b.status AS "state", b.external_id AS "build", b.branch AS "branch", b.duration_seconds / 60.0 AS "duration_min", CASE WHEN b.status <> 'CANCELED' THEN b.duration_seconds / 60.0 * 0.008 ELSE 0 END AS "cost_usd" FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND b.is_failure AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event ORDER BY b.started_at DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: 高延遲 PR 清單（review latency 由高到低）
panels.description: 含未 review PR（lower bound）。latency_h 欄位點擊可開啟 GitHub PR。

targets.rawSql: SELECT pr.pr_created_at AS created, m.display_name AS member, r.full_name AS repo, pr.number AS pr_number, pr.size_bucket AS size, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(pr.first_review_at, pr.merged_at, pr.closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0, 1) AS latency_h, (pr.closed_at IS NULL AND pr.merged_at IS NULL) AS opening, 'https://github.com/' || r.full_name || '/pull/' || pr.number AS url FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = pr.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY latency_h DESC LIMIT 200
